intro: The backlog is grouped into twelve epics. Priority uses MoSCoW as applied at the time the item was pulled; size is a Fibonacci story-point estimate. Status is factual, not aspirational — Done means the behaviour was verified in source at v2.20.2, and Open means it is not in the code today.
The Evidence column names the artefact that proves the item, so a reviewer can check any row without reading the whole system.
legend: Architectural or platform work with no direct user surface
Deliberate simplification carrying a known cost

epics.name: Platform, Identity & Access
epics.outcome: A signed-in account has exactly the reach its role and reporting line allow, and nothing more.

epics.name: Performance Management
epics.outcome: Every review has one accountable author, one voice, and a freeze date nobody can argue with.

epics.name: Competency & Credentialing
epics.outcome: The hospital can state, per employee, which skills are short and which licences are about to lapse.

epics.name: AI Competency Gap Analysis
epics.outcome: Gap narratives are grounded in what was actually written about a person, under explicit data-sharing controls.

epics.name: Learning & Compliance
epics.outcome: Mandatory training and CPD renewal can be assigned, measured, and reported to an accreditor.

epics.name: Training Logistics
epics.outcome: Sessions can be scheduled, filled, attended and evaluated without double-booking a room.

epics.name: Succession Planning
epics.outcome: HR can map critical-role pipelines confidentially while supervisors still develop their own people.

epics.name: Social Recognition
epics.outcome: Appreciation is attributable and audience-controlled, in public or in private.

epics.name: AI Assistant & Automation
epics.outcome: Staff can ask and act in natural language, bounded by the same RBAC as the UI.

epics.name: Notifications & Alerts
epics.outcome: An expiry or shortfall reaches a human who can act on it, once.

epics.name: UI Shell, Search & Design System
epics.outcome: One shell, one stylesheet, one modal controller, and a search that respects permissions.

epics.name: Platform Hardening & Non-Functional
epics.outcome: The system's own rules are enforced by tests, and its documentation matches its code.
